name: Archmage Arugal keeps fighting a player on the ledge lip at his Shadow Port spot (#13138)
contract: #13138: Arugal (4275) resets when his target leaves his lair polygon, on every difficulty. At 50% health and through Shadow Port 7587 he stands on the south ledge (-103.5, 2122.1), only 0.2 yd inside the old south edge, while the ledge floor reaches 1.25 yd past it, so players fighting him there reset him.

p stands on the ledge lip at (-103.68, 2121.45), 0.5 yd outside the old edge and 2.75 yd inside the new one, with ledge floor under it. A summoned Arugal 3 yd east runs the same SmartAI and leash as his spawn.
Expected: Arugal stays in combat and visible for 5 s while p stays on the lip. shadowfang-arugal-resets-when-target-leaves-lair still covers the reset outside the lair.

steps.label: CONTROL: p is in a Normal Shadowfang Keep
Join world phase 1, where Shadowfang Keep is spawned
p steps onto the ledge lip
CONTROL: ledge floor is under the lip spot
CONTROL: p stands on the lip
CONTROL: p is still on the lip
DISCRIMINATING: Arugal is still in combat with p on the lip
DISCRIMINATING: Arugal did not reset and vanish
